reviews.t: Big benefits in a tiny package
reviews.x: Surprisingly refreshing!  The prongs in this are soft and flexible, yet firm enough to provide gentle stimulation to the scalp. Short hair- my husband very much enjoyed the scrubbing massage and is hooked, despite thinking I was crazy asking him to try this! Long hair- I was concerned it would tangle or not provide good stimulation but it worked beautifully! DRY HAIR- I suffer from migraines and this little gem feels amazing to relieve pressure! Tried out if desperation and it really helped. Bab

I have curly hair and can't use a traditional hair brush so this shampoo brush is essential. It is soft yet firm which makes it do the job well. I really like this brush. The best shampoo brush I've ever used!

It fell apart after 10 seconds of use and was not fixable. I contacted the seller stating my problem and informed them that I would give them the opportunity to make it right before I made a scathing review. I didn't hear back from them so this is my scathing review.  I will not waste my time and effort to return it.  So disappointed!  It was nice for 10 seconds though.

reviews.t: Do not recommend this product is useless.
reviews.x: Cheaply made the silicone brush will detatch during use and it's not easy to snap it back. It very lightly exfoliates your scalp because the silicone brush heads are hollow and deform under the  pressure of brushing.  Useless do not buy this.
The product fits perfectly in your hand. The soft silicone bristles massage and clean your scalp well. My husband, son, and myself tried it. We all loved it.

I really like this scalp massager/hair cleaner brush. I use it in the shower to help make sure the shampoo is scrubbed in all the way and then to help rinse the shampoo out (using it like a brush).  The bristles (if you can call them that) are so soft and even though they are pointy, they don't hurt at all like other brushes do. The bristles are a silicone feel (not sure what it's actually made of) and the brush is easy to hold. Very impressed.

reviews.t: Works great for someone who is tinder headed
reviews.x: I honestly didn't know how awesome and useful these little things are! I'm supper tender headed. I was also worried that this would tangle up my hair but it didn't.  The little stubby nubs/bristles are soft, hollow and pliable allowing for the hair to glide through them easily. The handle fits perfectly in the palm of my hand, seriously. I honestly didn't think something like this would work but it's awesome!

**update** I tried to stick it out to see if the seal was misaligned or if I was being too rough with it. I believe it is a design flaw which lead to mold growth. I initiated a return this week.  Original Review: Water gets under the silicone pad and into the plastic hand/clear space with every use. I have to open and air dry every time or mold starts showing up. I will likely be returning this.

reviews.t: Horrible squeak on clean hair, otherwise great
reviews.x: I'd love to give this a higher rating, but the noise it makes when your hair is clean is deafening.  It's this horrible deep pitched squeaking that resonates in your head.  Too bad because otherwise it works great and the pricing is right.  I guess you could call it a "feature" as it lets you know when the soap is gone, but man is it loud.

This was “OK” until it feel apart. Now I can’t keep it together. I possibly could try to glue it. But I would have to buy some glue that would not break down with the water. Possibly a silicone glue. Definitely not worth the time or money spent time repair. It was soft and easy to use. While I was able to use it. Maybe a week

This shampoo brush feels soft enough on the scalp that I didn't worry that it might be contributing to breakage. It was also easy to hold. Although, it is a good product for what it is I personally would prefer to use my fingers but if they are ever cramping badly or something this would be a good alternative.

For how inexpensively it is made, it is a GREAT scalp massager. It's easy to hold, easy to use, and the cone "bristles" are really comfortable.  They give a definite massage, never collapsing into mush, yet are soft enough to never hurt the scalp.  I'm glad I got this and gladly recommend it.

reviews.t: Great for Scalp with Thick Hair!
reviews.x: I love using this! Was tired of using my nails/fingers to massage and clean my scalp. I have really thick poofy hair, so I feel like I don't get the best clean with just my 10 fingers lol! But with this brush I can press and massage and clean my scalp in swirls so I can get a better clean!

I use this ever shower. It’s great for getting product, dandruff, or whatever off your scalp in the hard to reach places. Plus it feels great! It is easy to hold and fits nicely in your hand. It is also a manicure saver if you paint your nails. Can’t imagine not using this.

This brush doesn't reach the scalp at all.  The bristles are silicone, so they won't scratch the scalp, but they also reach through the hair, or comb the hair properly.  This was a complete waste of money.  It's just not effective.

Very good quality. Feels good on the scalp and works great. I haven't had it too long but water getting stuck inside of it and creating mold doesn't seem to be a problem with this one. Easy gripping too.
[[VIDEOID:b9db38ad3d7b98f380842ac79952485c]] This massager feels great and is easy to hold. I use it to apply leave in conditioner for shiny, soft hair and a refreshed scalp. Highly recommend!
I didn’t even know these things existed. It feels so nice on my scalp, I even had my children try it, it helped them wash their hair better. It was like a toy, something they wanted to use.
I’m so glad I purchased this scalp massager. It’s easy to hold, fits perfectly in my hand and is very lightweight. I feels so nice on my scalp and makes my shampoo lather really nicely.
This feels really good on your scalp when using during shampooing. I was concerned it might tangle my hair, but it does not. Fits well in my hand, is lightweight and works very well.

reviews.t: the little massage points are very flexible. No harm to scalp and no pain, either.
reviews.x: It is comfortable and easy to use. Very gentle on scalp. The ease with which you can use it will cause you to use it more often which is a good thing for both you and your scalp.
Cleans my hair well. It’s especially nice as we enter this colder weather, to help with some scalp itchiness. It fits perfectly in my hand and is super easy to use.
This scalp massager is perfect for scrubbing my scalp. Not too hard, like some I've tried before, but hard enough that it actually feels like it's doing something.
Really like this. Does a great job of loosening dirt & oils so when you wash you hair it really get your hair clean. My cat loves to be brushed with it too!
I never even knew they made something like this before and I’m so glad I bought it! I use it every single time I take a shower and it doesn’t pull your hair

claims.text: Many reviewers find the soft silicone bristles comfortable and effective for massaging and cleaning the scalp, with several calling it a must-have or great product.
Several reviewers report the brush falls apart or detaches during use, with some describing it as cheaply made and not fixable.
Reviewers frequently praise the ergonomic design, noting it fits well in the hand and is easy to hold and use.
A few reviewers report problems with water getting under the silicone pad leading to mold, or the bristles being too soft to reach the scalp effectively.
Some reviewers note drawbacks such as a loud squeaking noise on clean hair or personal preference for using fingers instead.
